design: All 730 SDK perception frames replayed causally on each isolated branch, without changing the active checkout.
Native comparisons use each branch temporal configuration and identical SDK adapter, replay reconstruction and tracking configuration.
Policy-only comparison feeds current states to both classifiers, projecting away fields not present in the old strict schema.
The current-with-old-temporal control isolates threshold changes; all scenarios retain the same source hashes.
DEFER is normalized to null action, with original transport decision and reason retained.
First outputs are policy proposals; robot acceptance, command execution, survey endpoints and LLM inference are not evaluated.
